# Data Source S3 Services

Retrieves S3 server configurations for all or matched SVMs in the cluster

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver object-store-server show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.8 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
# retrieving all S3 server configurations
data "netapp-ontap_s3_services" "all_s3_servers" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
}

# retrieving S3 server configurations for matched SVMs
data "netapp-ontap_s3_services" "matched_s3_servers" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  filter = {
    svm_name = "svm*"
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_s3_services"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_s3_services`

Required:

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

Read-Only:

- `certificate_name` (String) Indicates the certificate being used for creating HTTPS connections to the S3 server.
- `comment` (String) Additional information about the S3 server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether or not the S3 server is enabled.
- `is_http_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether HTTP is enabled on the S3 server.
- `is_https_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether HTTPS is enabled on the S3 server.
- `name` (String) The name of the S3 server.
- `port` (Number) Indicates the HTTP listener port for the S3 server.
- `secure_port` (Number) Indicates the HTTPS listener port for the S3 server.
